title:
Epic for handling expected sensor selection for an {@link AssetClass}.
Triggered when the 'Existing' or 'Custom' buttons are clicked.
Updates the visibility of the form field sets based on the selection:
If 'Existing' is clicked, it hides the custom field set and shows the existing field set.
If 'Custom' is clicked, it hides the existing field set and shows the custom field set.
name: AssetClassDetailExpectedSensorSidePanelFormTypeEpic
